text:
morgan: Just merged #4125 (kvcache: avoid double-flush) into main — saw CI go red immediately, failing job `full-integration-09` :rotating_light: Can someone take a quick look?
ci-bot: build failed on main - job `full-integration-09` (tests/integration/test_kv_cache.py::TestKVCache::test_flush_on_eviction). Logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/jenkins/job/1710739200/9/console 
sam-infra: @morgan thanks for the ping. @raj can you triage? If it's a flaky integration we can rerun quick. If it reproduces locally we might need a revert. :eyes: 
raj: On it. Kicking off a rerun now: `/ci rerun job=full-integration-09 build=1710739200` 
ci-bot: Rerun queued (build 1710739200-2) — estimated 4m 
raj: rerun result: passed ✅ but main still red, new failure in `lint-acceptance` job (tests/lint/acceptance_checks.sh)
jen-qa: I pulled the acceptance logs — failing step is `integration smoke tests` timeout (timeout after 300s). Looks like a timing regression, test name `test_canary_timeout`.
morgan: I only changed kvcache codepaths, didn't touch rollout timing. The merged change reduced cache hits which could slow startup? Not sure.
raj: good catch — kvcache change could increase cold-start tokens and length of setup. Can someone share the commit range between last green and current?
infra-oncall: last green on main was build 1710738000 (sha: a1b2c3d). Current head sha: f9e8d7c (from morgan's merge). I'll run a binary bisect script: `/scripts/ci/bisect --start a1b2c3d --end f9e8d7c --jobs full-integration-09,lint-acceptance`
sam-infra: Meanwhile, do we want to hold auto-promote? I'm pausing the deploy pipeline for main until triage completes.
morgan: If bisect points to my PR, I'm ready to revert immediately. Want me to start a revert PR now? :shipit: 
raj: Let's wait for bisect quick run (should be ~10 mins). If bisect shows my infra tweak is culprit, I can push a hotfix. If it's morgan's change, revert will be fastest.
ci-bot: bisect run started (id 8821). Progress updates in this thread.
jen-qa: Reproducer attempt locally: `pytest tests/integration/test_kv_cache.py::TestKVCache::test_flush_on_eviction -k test_canary_timeout -q` — got the timeout after 4 runs, flaky but reproducible with lower resources.
raj: hypothesis: kvcache reduces cache hits -> more I/O during startup -> pushes timing of canary check beyond timeout. Quick mitigation: increase canary timeout in test harness to 600s, rerun.
infra-oncall: bisect finished: culprit commit narrowed to range including morgan's merge (sha f9e8d7c).
morgan: OK — starting revert PR now: `git revert -m 1 f9e8d7c && git push origin revert/kvcache-double-flush`
sam-infra: Thanks. I'll keep the deploy paused and monitor CI. Once revert PR merges and passes we can unpause.
raj: We'll also make a follow-up to add a unit test for startup latency in kvcache. Assigning to me.
ci-bot: revert PR build (1710739800) queued.
jen-qa: test harness change suggestion: in parallel, I'll open a small PR to increase the canary timeout in flaky environments to reduce noise.
morgan: Revert merged, main CI rerun in progress. Sorry folks — will follow up with a postmortem note and a checklist to prevent similar regressions.
ci-bot: main is green again — all checks passed. :tada: Last message: build 1710739819
sam-infra: Great job triaging. Action items: (1) raj to add kvcache startup test, (2) morgan to follow up w/ postmortem + revert checklist, (3) jen-qa to open timeout tweak PR. I'll unpause deploys in 10m if no regressions.
